title: Comparatives & Superlatives
completion_message: ¡Felicidades! Has completado el primer Hito del Nivel A2. Ahora sabes comparar cosas como todo un líder.

parts.visual: Comparativos (2 cosas): Adjetivos cortos + ER + than (cheap -> cheaper than / barato -> más barato que). Adjetivos largos: more + adjetivo + than (expensive -> more expensive than).
parts.audio: Comparatives, used to compare 2 things. For short adjectives, add E-R and 'than'. Cheap becomes cheaper than. For long adjectives, use 'more', the adjective, and 'than'. Expensive becomes more expensive than.

parts.visual: Superlativos (3 o más cosas): The + adjetivo corto + EST (the cheapest / el más barato). The + most + adjetivo largo (the most expensive / el más caro). Irregulares: good -> better -> the best. bad -> worse -> the worst.
parts.audio: Superlatives, used to compare 3 or more things. For short adjectives, use 'the' and add E-S-T. The cheapest. For long adjectives, use 'the most'. The most expensive. Irregulars: good becomes better, and the best. Bad becomes worse, and the worst.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige el comparativo o superlativo correcto.

questions.question: This software is ____ than the old one. (Adjetivo corto: fast).
questions.explanation: Comparativo de adjetivo corto: fast + er = faster.

questions.question: This is ____ software in the market. (Adjetivo corto: fast).
questions.explanation: Superlativo (el más rápido de todos): the fastest.

questions.question: London is ____ than Madrid. (Adjetivo largo: expensive).
questions.explanation: Comparativo de adjetivo largo: more + expensive.

questions.question: Tokyo is ____ city in the world. (Adjetivo largo: expensive).
questions.explanation: Superlativo de adjetivo largo: the most + expensive.

questions.question: My new computer is ____ than my old one. (Irregular: good).
She is ____ employee in the company. (Irregular: good).
This year's sales are ____ than last year's. (Irregular: bad).
That was ____ presentation I have ever seen. (Irregular: bad).
questions.explanation: El superlativo de 'bad' es 'the worst' (el peor de todos).

questions.question: A laptop is ____ than a desktop. (Adjetivo corto terminado en Y: heavy).
questions.explanation: Los terminados en 'y' cambian a 'i' + er: heavier.

questions.question: The CEO's office is ____ in the building. (Adjetivo corto: big).
questions.explanation: Superlativo de big (doble consonante): the biggest.

questions.question: This process is ____ efficient than the old one. (Adjetivo largo).
questions.explanation: Comparativo (2 cosas) de adjetivo largo: more efficient than.

questions.question: Who is ____ successful manager in the team? (Adjetivo largo).
questions.explanation: Superlativo (de todo el equipo) de adjetivo largo: the most successful.

questions.question: This option is ____. (Más barata).
It is ____ than walking. (Adjetivo largo: dangerous).
This is ____ difficult task I have ever done. (Superlativo largo).
My desk is ____ than yours. (Adjetivo corto: small).
Today is ____ day of the year. (Adjetivo corto terminado en Y: busy).
We need to work ____ than before. (Adjetivo irregular: hard).
It is ____ important to focus on quality. (Más).
She makes ____ money in the company. (Superlativo: mucha/más de todos).
questions.explanation: The most money = la mayor cantidad de dinero.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el comparativo o superlativo correcto.

questions.question: This is ____ than that. (fast - comparativo)
This is ____ car in the world. (fast - superlativo)
Gold is ____ expensive than silver. (comparativo)
This is ____ most expensive watch. (superlativo)
My phone is ____ than yours. (good - comparativo irregular)
She is ____ best employee. (superlativo de good)
This year is ____ than last year. (bad - comparativo irregular)
That is ____ worst idea. (superlativo de bad)
It is ____ than my bag. (heavy - comparativo, cambia y por i)
It is the ____ office. (big - superlativo, doble g)

pairs.target: Rápido / Más rápido / El más rápido
Pesado / Más pesado / El más pesado
Grande / Más grande / El más grande

This software is fast than the old one.
The software is faster than the old one.

This is the fastest computer in the market.
